snippet.title: The Wishing Stone - Puzzle Adventure/Visual Novel Game Character Art Update
snippet.description:
Steam page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1330100

The Wishing Stone is a captivating point-and-click puzzle adventure game with challenging puzzles and a mysterious visual novel storyline. 

We have just made updates to the character art in the game to make the experience better.
